text:
This is a stainless steel mixing bowl, roughly 25-28 cm across at the rim. The visible contents are shaved cheese on top of sliced red onion, cherry tomatoes, green pepper and a few carrot shreds.

The cheese is a pile of parmesan-style shavings about 12 cm across and 3 cm high, loosely packed, so I estimate about 50 g. The red onion is thinly sliced and spread over the pile, about 40 g. The cherry tomatoes are mostly hidden, so I count about 6 pieces at roughly 70 g. The green pepper is a small amount, about 20 g. The carrot shreds are minor, about 8 g. There may be a little oil or dressing at the bottom, about 10 g. A few pieces of chicken or other pale items appear to be mixed in, about 30 g.
